intended_use: One wearer, right missing hand; fitted use not yet authorised by evidence

gates.requirement: Prescribed socket, suspension, alignment, EMG site and wearer-specific fitting evidence
Identified and dimensionally verified servo, horn, fastener, electronics and power parts
Qualified material, printing process, dimensional inspection and traceable build record
Complete routes, terminations, force/travel measurements and continuous moving clearance
Validated accessible mechanical release during power loss, motor seizure and tendon jam
Agreed design loads and verified palm, cover, mounts, straps and axle strength/fatigue
Rated supply/protection/wiring plus measured current, noise, sag and temperature
Physical timing, EMG artefact/electrode-loss, false activation, inversion calibration and fault tests
Predefined cycle-life and wear criteria with recorded repeated-load results
Supervised fitting/functional trial evidence and follow-up/maintenance instructions
Responsible manufacturer/professional confirms applicable pathway and obligations
